details.shipping: Shipping across Europe from our hub in Belgium

items.name: bpost · tracked parcel
items.note: Books leave our European hub in Belgium and travel to your address with tracking all the way.

items.name: Made-to-order merch
items.note: Merch is printed and shipped by our print partner in its own parcel. It does not reach every country — Belarus, for one — and checkout tells you if yours is an exception.

items.name: Digital editions
items.note: E-books are emailed right after payment — nothing is shipped.

items.title: Choose books
items.desc: Add everything you like to the cart and proceed to checkout.

items.title: Enter the address
items.desc: We deliver across Europe — the rate is quoted for your exact address at checkout.

items.title: Pay online
items.desc: Secure card payment via Stripe — no account required.

items.title: Get a tracking number
items.desc: The parcel leaves our European hub and we email the tracking number.

items.a: Yes. All payments are processed by Stripe, a PCI-DSS Level 1 certified provider. We never see or store your card details.

items.q: How long does the parcel take?
items.a: Usually 2–10 business days after dispatch, counted from our European hub. We email the tracking number as soon as the parcel ships.

Not within the EU: the parcel ships from Belgium, so the price at checkout is final. Outside the EU — the UK, Switzerland, Norway, Belarus and others — the parcel crosses a customs border, and local customs may add duty or VAT under their own rules. We do not collect that payment and cannot influence it.

items.q: Can I collect the order from a parcel point?
items.a: In Belgium, France and the Netherlands you can pick a bpost parcel point at checkout. Everywhere else we deliver to your address.
Payment goes through Stripe, and some cards issued in Belarus are declined by the bank rather than by us. If yours does not go through, write to us and we will agree on another way.
It depends on what you ordered — e-books, physical books, and made-to-order merch each work differently. See the full breakdown below.
